RETRACTED.consequence: the per-component aggregates are inflated by duplication and the per-turn decomposition is meaningless. The individual call measurements (prefill, decode, tokens, finish_reason) are real, but their attribution is not.
RETRACTED.reason: correlation was done by wall-clock window overlap, so the same inference seconds were attributed to several turns at once and to turns that never called the model. turn-23 received 5.647 s of inference for a 0.0015 s deterministic turn (x3765); turn-03 and turn-06 were each given the identical 6.981 s, i.e. the same calls double counted. Every one of the 12 cases exceeded its own wall time.

not_this: this is NOT equivalent_overhead_ab_20260730.json, which compares LlmRuntime.chat against a direct POST and carries no information about the policy components
what_this_is: the real turn policy pipeline decomposed per component. Every wire call of P, G, L, V, C, the selector, clarify generation, plan skeleton and chat is attributed and reported with payload hash, prompt/cached/predicted tokens, prefill and decode times, finish reason, attempt index and the contractual decision of its turn.
